cases.title: 浏览器中的 Minecraft 克隆
cases.summary: 作者展示在浏览器中运行的 Minecraft 克隆测试，呈现这次游戏生成的结果。

cases.title: 单个 HTML 的机械主题游戏

cases.title: 蜘蛛侠游戏的三模型对比
cases.summary: 作者以蜘蛛侠游戏为题，比较 Opus 5.5、Fable 5.1 和 GPT-6 Astra 的生成结果。
cases.summary_en: The author compares Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra on a Spider-Man game task.
cases.author: @k2sbhai

cases.title: 带水物理的 Minecraft 克隆
cases.summary: 作者展示包含水物理与游戏机制的 Minecraft 克隆，并提供试玩链接；作者认为结果优于 Astra，但这次模型运行比 Astra 更慢。

cases.summary: 作者展示约 1.3 万行 Three.js 制作的《使命召唤》僵尸模式风格玩法，包含拆窗木板、神秘箱、Pack-a-Punch、Jugg、Ray Gun 与 BO1 回合机制。作者称没有素材文件，纹理、嘶吼和提示音均由代码生成。

cases.summary_en: The author reports one initial prompt and about two refinement rounds for a snow game, with the model working for over an hour. The demo includes snow spray, trees, tracks, lighting, shadows and sound effects.

cases.title: 另一则武士游戏转发

cases.summary_en: In this disclosed partnership post, an author with early model access reports adding game features and editing a trailer, and provides a playable link.
cases.author: @ForwardEditor

cases.title: Tesana 多人生存岛

cases.summary_en: The author reports making an ARK-style multiplayer survival island in Tesana with a few prompts, featuring quests, dinosaur taming, crafting and combat, then playing with two friends. The claimed 30+ hours of gameplay is self-reported; the report flags a possible, unconfirmed partnership.

cases.summary_en: The author uses the same prompt to compare Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3 flight simulators, showing UI, multiple camera angles and voice. Both reportedly run smoothly, while Kimi K3 is more cost-efficient.

cases.summary_en: Using the same single prompt and only Blender, the author compares procedural ten-second shots and build timelapses. They report Opus at 35m, 199.6k output tokens and about $13.3 in API terms, versus GPT-6 Astra at 28m, 56.6k tokens and about $14.5.

cases.title: DeLorean 与钟楼闪电动画

cases.title: 同段街景视频的对象跟踪标注
cases.title_en: Tracking labels in the same street footage
cases.summary: Higgsfield 平台在同一段街景视频上比较 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 的数据标注，展示叠加标签随镜头运动跟踪人、建筑和物体。属于平台效果对照，未给出标注准确率。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield compares Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra on the same street video, showing overlays following people, buildings and objects as the camera moves. This is a platform comparison without reported labeling-accuracy measurements.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 官方转发的西瓜故事短片
cases.summary: Claude 官方账号将 Kevin Ngo 的西瓜故事短片列为 Opus 5.5 的早期探索。该帖是官方二手展示，没有提供独立制作复现。
cases.summary_en: Claude’s official account shares Kevin Ngo’s short story about a watermelon as an early Opus 5.5 exploration. This is an official secondhand showcase, not an independent reconstruction of the production.
cases.author: @claudeai

cases.title: Medeo 中驱动 Seedance 2.5 的对比
cases.summary: Medeo 平台比较 GPT-6 Sol 与 Opus 5.5 驱动 Seedance 2.5 制作的视频，侧重场景理解和细节。这是语言模型编排视频生成工具的流程，视频生成由 Seedance 2.5 完成。
cases.summary_en: Medeo compares videos made with GPT-6 Sol and Opus 5.5 driving Seedance 2.5, focusing on scene understanding and detail. This is a language-model orchestration workflow; Seedance 2.5 performs the video generation.
cases.author: @Medeo_AI

cases.title: 在 Claude 网页调用 Blender 做黏土动画
cases.title_en: Making claymation with Blender in Claude
cases.summary: 平台相关作者展示在 claude.ai 中通过一条提示调用 Blender 制作黏土动画。动画制作依赖 Blender，并非仅由语言模型直接输出视频。
cases.summary_en: A platform-affiliated author demonstrates using Blender from claude.ai to make claymation with a single prompt. The animation workflow depends on Blender rather than the language model directly generating video.
cases.author: @alexalbert__

cases.title: Tesseract 重制发布视频的成本对比
cases.summary: Tesseract 平台将 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 分别接入自家视频工具，重制自己的发布视频并展示成本对比。结果包含 Tesseract 的编辑和渲染贡献。
cases.summary_en: Tesseract’s team pairs Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra with its own video tool to recreate its launch video and compare costs. Tesseract contributes the editing and rendering capabilities.
cases.author: @trymirage

cases.title: 为 DocJev 制作文档工具预告片
cases.summary: DocJev 作者展示用 Opus 5.5 制作的产品预告片。该帖将文档分类与拆分核心归于 Jev 工具链，不能把预告片制作归因为 Opus 实现了文档处理核心。
cases.summary_en: DocJev’s author showcases a product teaser made with Opus 5.5. The post attributes the document-classification and splitting core to the Jev toolchain; making the teaser does not establish that Opus built that core.
cases.author: @jerryjliu0

cases.title: 用自有 skill 制作 Claude 模型发展史
cases.title_en: A Claude model history using a custom skill
cases.summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 制作 Claude 模型发展史，并称成片由纯 JavaScript 加上自己的 skill 完成。该结果依赖作者提供的 skill。
cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 to make a history of Claude model development and reports producing it in pure JavaScript with their own skill. That custom skill is part of the workflow.
cases.author: @superalesha

cases.title: Medeo 的折纸老虎视频对比
cases.summary: Medeo 平台比较 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 制作的折纸老虎视频，两条流程均使用 Seedance 2.5 生成画面。这里展示的是语言模型驱动视频工具，不能当成 Opus 的原生视频生成。
cases.summary_en: Medeo compares origami-tiger videos made using Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, with Seedance 2.5 generating the video in both workflows. The showcase concerns language models directing a video tool, not native video generation by Opus.
cases.author: @Medeo_AI

cases.title: Remotion 制作 BridgeMind 卫衣宣传片
cases.title_en: A BridgeMind hoodie promo with Remotion
cases.summary: BridgeMind 平台展示用 Opus 5.5 与 Remotion 制作的自家卫衣发售视频。发布方认为转场、节奏和品牌表现优于其以往的 Fable 5.1 与 GPT-6 Astra 输出，这是自家宣传中的主观比较。
cases.summary_en: BridgeMind showcases a hoodie-launch video made with Opus 5.5 and Remotion. Its publisher prefers the transitions, timing and branding to prior Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra outputs; this is a subjective comparison in a self-promotional showcase.
cases.author: @bridgemindai

cases.title: Higgsfield 商业视频的时间与费用
cases.title_en: Time and cost for a Higgsfield commercial
cases.summary: Higgsfield 平台对比商业视频制作，报告 Opus 5.5 用时 60 分钟、50 美元，GPT-6 Astra 用时 82 分钟、97 美元。数值来自平台自己的制作展示。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield compares commercial-video production, reporting 60 minutes and $50 for Opus 5.5 versus 82 minutes and $97 for GPT-6 Astra. These figures come from the platform’s own production showcase.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 从发布帖编写纯代码宣传视频
cases.title_en: A launch video coded from a release post
cases.summary: 作者把原始发布帖交给 Opus 5.5，让其用 JavaScript 制作发布视频，称没有使用外部音乐、音效或图片素材，全部由代码实现。
cases.summary_en: The author supplies the original release post and asks Opus 5.5 to code a launch video in JavaScript, reporting that all music, sound and imagery were made in code without external assets.
cases.author: @chetaslua

cases.title: 转发 Claude 视角的定格动画
cases.title_en: A shared stop-motion view through Claude’s eyes
cases.summary: 帖子转述「通过 Claude 的眼睛看世界」的定格动画创作，并称片中内容均由 Opus 5.5 制作。属于二手展示，具体工具链未交代。
cases.summary_en: The post shares a stop-motion animation about seeing the world through Claude’s eyes and claims Opus 5.5 made everything in it. It is a secondhand showcase without a specified toolchain.
cases.author: @satori_sz9

cases.title: 从两秒迭代到 22 秒的配乐视频
cases.title_en: Iterating a scored video from two to 22 seconds
cases.summary: 作者展示三版视频，时长从 2 秒扩展到 17 秒，再到最终 22 秒，并称配乐也由 Opus 5.5 用代码完成。
cases.summary_en: The author shows three versions extending a video from two seconds to 17 and then 22 seconds, and reports using Opus 5.5 to code its music as well.
cases.author: @dhruvalgolakiya

cases.title: Photoshop 与 Fusion 修补视频错误
cases.title_en: Fixing video artifacts with Photoshop and Fusion
cases.summary: Higgsfield 平台展示 Opus 5.5 调用 Photoshop 和 DaVinci Resolve Fusion，修补 AI 视频中的渲染错误。平台称几分钟完成了过去需数小时的手工工作，节省时间未经独立复核。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield showcases Opus 5.5 using Photoshop and DaVinci Resolve Fusion to repair rendering errors in an AI-generated video. The platform claims minutes instead of hours of manual work; that time saving has not been independently verified.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 从 Kotlin 网站制作宣传视频
cases.title_en: A Kotlin promo from its website
cases.summary: JetBrains 平台展示团队成员向 Opus 5.5 提供 HeyGen 的 HyperFrames skills，并指向 Kotlin 网站制作宣传片。作品依赖这些 skills 提供的视频制作流程。
cases.summary_en: JetBrains showcases a team member giving Opus 5.5 HeyGen’s HyperFrames skills and pointing it at the Kotlin website to make a promo. The production workflow depends on those skills.
cases.author: @jetbrains

cases.title: 按个人风格剪辑原始拍摄素材
cases.title_en: Editing raw footage to match a personal style
cases.summary: 作者提供含录制错误的原始视频和一个参考示例，称只用一条提示就让 Opus 5.5 按自己的剪辑风格处理素材。效果匹配程度来自作者评价，输入包含参考样片。
cases.summary_en: The author provides raw footage containing recording mistakes and a reference example, reporting that one prompt made Opus 5.5 edit it in their usual style. The style match is the author’s assessment, and the workflow includes reference footage.
cases.author: @gabrielbuzziv

cases.title: 把 Coinacademy 文章改成 FLOP Labs 视频
cases.title_en: Turning a Coinacademy article into a FLOP Labs video
cases.summary: 作者以自家 Coinacademy 文章为输入，用两次提示让 Opus 5.5 制作 FLOP Labs 的介绍视频。
cases.summary_en: The author uses their Coinacademy article as input and reports making a FLOP Labs introduction video with Opus 5.5 in two prompts.
cases.author: @Capetlevrai

cases.title: 转发 Drew 的 Opus 5.5 视频
cases.title_en: A shared Opus 5.5 video by Drew
cases.summary: 帖子转发 Drew 用 Opus 5.5 制作的视频并评价其审美，未说明具体脚本、工具或完整制作流程。属于二手作品展示。
cases.summary_en: The post shares a video made by Drew with Opus 5.5 and comments on its taste, without specifying scripts, tools or the full production process. It is a secondhand showcase.
cases.author: @cheatyyyy

cases.title: 与 GPT-6 Sol 的视频结果对照
cases.title_en: Video outputs compared with GPT-6 Sol
cases.summary: 作者并列展示 GPT-6 Sol 与 Opus 5.5 制作的视频，正文没有说明具体提示词、脚本或生成工具链。
cases.summary_en: The author places videos attributed to GPT-6 Sol and Opus 5.5 side by side, without specifying the prompt, scripts or production toolchain in the post.
cases.author: @matiass

cases.title: 用代码制作 serai 宣传视频
cases.title_en: A coded promotional video for serai
cases.summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 通过代码为 serai 制作宣传视频，并分享成片展示。正文没有交代具体编辑或渲染工具。
cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 to create a promotional video for serai through code and shares the result. The post does not specify editing or rendering tools.
cases.author: @Avenoxai

cases.title: Cowork 制作 Opus 5.5 解说视频
cases.title_en: An Opus 5.5 explainer made in Cowork
cases.summary: 作者在 Cowork 中让 Opus 5.5 制作介绍自身的解说视频，并称全程没有调用外部 API。视频中的模型能力与价格介绍属于其内容，不是该制作过程独立验证的结论。
cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 to make an explainer about itself in Cowork and reports using no external APIs. The video’s capability and pricing statements are its subject matter, not conclusions independently verified by making it.
cases.author: @genel_ai

cases.title: 视频作品与尚未实施的 fal 组合设想
cases.title_en: A video showcase and a planned fal combination
cases.summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 独立完成了展示的视频，但没有说明渲染工具链。文中与 fal、尤其 H3 Max 的组合仍是后续想法，不能当作已完成集成。
cases.summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 made the featured video on its own, without specifying the rendering toolchain. Combining it with fal, especially H3 Max, is described as a future idea rather than a completed integration.
cases.author: @ailker

cases.title: 从 UGC 文件夹剪辑并制作文字动画
cases.title_en: Editing UGC folders with animated text
cases.summary: 作者把 AI UGC 素材文件夹交给 Opus 5.5，通过 Tesseract 剪辑视频，并强调文字动画由 Tesseract 制作。演示支持素材剪辑工作流，未验证整套账号运营能够自动完成。
cases.summary_en: The author points Opus 5.5 at AI UGC folders and uses Tesseract to cut a video, emphasizing that Tesseract creates the text animations. The demo supports a footage-editing workflow, not verified automation of an entire content account.
cases.author: @hanifproduktif

cases.title: 游戏引擎阿拉伯文字教程视频
cases.title_en: A tutorial on Arabic text in game engines
cases.summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 编码制作教程，讲解不支持阿拉伯语的游戏引擎如何处理阿拉伯文字，自报编程用时 18 分钟。作品使用一张 logo 图片，声音来自 ElevenLabs，不能归为全部素材由 Opus 生成。
cases.summary_en: The author uses Opus 5.5 to code a tutorial about Arabic text in game engines that do not support it, reporting 18 minutes of programming. The production also uses a logo image and ElevenLabs audio, so not every asset is generated by Opus.
cases.author: @sbalhatlani

cases.title: 105 缺陷评测增加 Sol 对照
cases.title_en: A Sol comparison added to the bug test
cases.summary: 同一双仓库缺陷评测新增 Sol 结果；后续帖报告 Opus max 41.7 分、58.53 美元，与早期 43 个、60.49 美元口径不同，不能直接视为模型能力变化。
cases.summary_en: The two-repository 105-bug test now reports Opus max at 41.7 and $58.53; this differs from the earlier 43/$60.49 report and does not establish capability change.
cases.author: @PawelHuryn

cases.title: CS2 作弊程序生成的作者展示
cases.summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 一次生成了 CS2 作弊程序，并展示相关结果。实际运行效果未核验，该帖只能作为作者自述记录。
cases.summary_en: The author claims Opus 5.5 generated a CS2 cheat program in one shot and shares a demonstration. Actual operation has not been verified; the entry records the author’s claim.
cases.author: @SingulCore

cases.title: 进行中的 circuit_eval 检查点评测
cases.summary: 作者用 Medium 档测试 Opus 5.5 的 circuit_eval 连续检查点表现，并对照 Opus 5 在第二个检查点后出错的情况。帖子发布时评测仍在进行，作者计划每十分钟更新，不能视为最终成绩。
cases.summary_en: The author tests Opus 5.5 at Medium effort on successive circuit_eval checkpoints, contrasting it with Opus 5’s reported error after the second checkpoint. The test was still running, with updates planned every ten minutes, so this is not a final result.
cases.author: @dexhorthy

cases.title: 同题解释期权概念的表达对比
cases.title_en: Comparing explanations of an options concept
cases.summary: 作者通过期权概念解释截图比较 Opus 5 与 Opus 5.5 的写作，认为新版更直接、自然。作者披露自己是提前测试者；这属于已披露的访问关系，未说明该帖商业条款。
cases.summary_en: Using screenshots explaining an options concept, the author compares Opus 5 and Opus 5.5 and judges the newer prose more direct and natural. The author discloses early-testing access; commercial terms for the post are not stated.
cases.author: @theojaffee

cases.title: 森林与河流背景的故事片段
cases.title_en: A story excerpt set around a forest and river
cases.summary: 媒体截图呈现以森林和河流为背景的故事片段，作者将其归于 Opus 5.5。原始提示词未提供，无法从片段还原完整写作任务。
cases.summary_en: The screenshot shows a story passage set around a forest and river, attributed by the author to Opus 5.5. The original prompt is absent, so the full writing brief cannot be reconstructed from the excerpt.
cases.author: @tessera_antra

cases.title: 十个 Agent 探索最短路径算法
cases.title_en: Ten agents exploring a shortest-path algorithm
cases.summary: Vals AI 发布自家实验：十个 Opus 5.5 Agent 在 15 小时内提出 C-HD 最短路径算法改进，并称用 Lean 完成形式化证明、改善已发表界限。资料未独立复核证明或实际运行收益，属于待复现的研究结果。
cases.summary_en: Vals AI reports its own experiment in which ten Opus 5.5 agents produced C-HD within 15 hours, claiming a Lean-formalized improvement over published shortest-path bounds. The evidence review did not independently verify the proof or practical runtime gains; the research claim remains to be reproduced.
cases.author: @ValsAI

cases.title: tscircuit 蓝牙音箱电路对比
cases.summary: tscircuit 相关作者用同一条「制作蓝牙音箱」指令，对比 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 的电路设计。属于自家工具展示，结果没有证明实体硬件已制作或通过测试。
cases.summary_en: A tscircuit-affiliated author compares Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra on the same request to make a Bluetooth speaker with tscircuit. This is a showcase of the author’s own tool, without evidence of fabricated or tested hardware.
cases.author: @seveibar

cases.title: 电路原理图绘制的耗时对比
cases.summary: 作者比较电路原理图绘制，报告 Opus 5.5 用时 8 分钟，Grok 4.7 用时 20 分钟，并认为前者质量更高。关于超越 Astra 的判断只是作者根据速度提出的看法。
cases.summary_en: The author reports an eight-minute circuit-schematic run with Opus 5.5 versus 20 minutes with Grok 4.7 and prefers Opus’s quality. The suggestion that it may outperform Astra is the author’s speed-based opinion.
cases.author: @i2cjak

cases.title: 用鼠标键盘在 Paintbrush 画蒙娜丽莎
cases.title_en: Drawing the Mona Lisa with a mouse in Paintbrush
cases.summary: Higgsfield 平台让两个模型仅用黑色笔画、鼠标和键盘在 Paintbrush 中绘制蒙娜丽莎。平台报告 Opus 5.5 用时 11 分 42 秒、估计 1.66 美元，GPT-6 Astra 用时 5 分 26 秒、估计 2.72 美元。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield asks both models to draw the Mona Lisa in Paintbrush using only black strokes and mouse-and-keyboard control. The platform reports 11m 42s and an estimated $1.66 for Opus 5.5, versus 5m 26s and an estimated $2.72 for GPT-6 Astra.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 水墨雨伞故事与代码配乐
cases.title_en: An ink-wash umbrella story with a coded score
cases.summary: 作者展示一把迷路雨伞帮助青蛙、蜗牛和鸭子一家避雨的短片，称水墨画面与配乐均由 Opus 5.5 用代码制作。
cases.summary_en: The author shows a short about a lost umbrella sheltering a frog, a snail and a duck with her ducklings, reporting that Opus 5.5 made both the ink-wash imagery and score in code.
cases.author: @dfeinition

cases.title: AppLlama MCP 重设计已有应用
cases.title_en: Redesigning an existing app with AppLlama MCP
cases.summary: 作者展示 Opus 5.5 配合 AppLlama MCP 对已有应用的一次重设计及前后对照。原应用的月经常性收入自报为 1 万美元，这不是此次重设计新增收入的证明。
cases.summary_en: The author shows before-and-after views of an existing app reportedly redesigned in one shot with Opus 5.5 and AppLlama MCP. The claimed $10,000 MRR belongs to the pre-existing app, not revenue proven to result from this redesign.
cases.author: @jaimintf

cases.title: 更快最短路径算法研究
cases.summary: HN 分享 Vals AI 的最短路径算法研究。讨论同时提醒：理论复杂度改进不等于已有工程加速，研究与形式化验证仍属原作者报告。
cases.summary_en: A Hacker News post shares Vals AI’s shortest-path research. Discussion distinguishes theoretical improvements from practical speedups; the research and formal-verification claims remain those of the original authors.
cases.author: leumon

cases.title: 四档 SVG 结果与 max 失败
cases.title_en: Four SVG outputs and a max-effort failure
cases.summary: 作者用 llm-anthropic 在 low、medium、high、xhigh 生成骑车鹈鹕 SVG，并公开命令和结果。max 档耗尽 128,000 输出 token 仍未答复，失败尝试花费 2.56 美元。
cases.summary_en: The author publishes commands and pelican-on-a-bicycle SVG outputs for low, medium, high and xhigh using llm-anthropic. Max exhausted 128,000 output tokens without answering; that failed attempt cost $2.56.
cases.author: simonw

cases.title: 解释仓库调度器的正确性
cases.summary: 作者要求简短解释仓库调度器，同时保留关键正确性细节，并展示实际输出。作者认为更易读，但同一回复串中的读者仍批评其比喻与句式。
cases.summary_en: The author asks for a brief scheduler explanation that preserves correctness details and shares the resulting text. They find it clearer, while readers in the same thread still criticize its metaphors and phrasing.
cases.author: epicepicurean

cases.title: 两次 max 鹈鹕绘图均未答复
cases.title_en: Two max-effort SVG attempts without an answer
cases.summary: 同一作者补充：两次 max 档骑车鹈鹕 SVG 请求，都在推理阶段耗尽 128,000 token 预算，未形成回答。帖子附有一次尝试的推理记录。
cases.summary_en: The same author reports two max-effort attempts at a pelican-on-a-bicycle SVG. Both exhausted a 128,000-token budget while reasoning, before an answer; the post links one attempt’s trace.
cases.author: simonw

cases.title: 系统开发任务被安全分类器中断
cases.summary: 作者自述嵌入式、驱动和系统级开发任务均在完成前触发 cyber 分类器。帖子记录其当日使用受阻，不足以证明所有系统开发或安全任务都会被拦截。
cases.summary_en: The author reports cyber-classifier interruptions before their embedded, driver and system-level tasks could finish. This describes their own experience that day, not a universal block on systems or security work.
cases.author: mintik

cases.title: 审读自建 Web 应用的安全问题
cases.title_en: Reviewing a personal web app for security issues
cases.summary: 作者让模型阅读自己开发的 Web 应用源码以查找安全问题，报告过程未被拒绝。这里仅做源码分析，作者明确没有让模型执行实际安全测试。
cases.summary_en: The author reports using the model to read their own web app’s source and identify security issues without a refusal. They explicitly distinguish source review from running security tests.
cases.author: doginasuit

cases.title: Minecraft 与 Warcraft 克隆对比
cases.summary: 作者公开两种游戏的 Opus 5.5、Fable 5.1 和 Astra 产物与提示词。Opus 在 Claude Code 的 xhigh 档约用 45 分钟，11—14 美元是订阅使用的 API 等价估算。
cases.summary_en: The author shares playable outputs and prompts for Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Astra across two games. Opus took about 45 minutes at xhigh in Claude Code; $11–14 is estimated API-equivalent usage on a subscription.
cases.author: senko

cases.title: 图片转 HTML 的还原与性能测试
cases.summary: 作者提供设计图与多模型页面输出。Opus 5.5 较好还原视觉，但漏做请求中的页面转场，运行性能也较差；作者在这次测试中仍更看好 Astra。
cases.summary_en: The author shares a design image and several models’ page outputs. Opus 5.5 follows the design but misses requested page transitions and performs poorly at runtime; the author still prefers Astra in this test.
cases.author: jjcm

cases.title: 12 个补丁中的 14 个问题
cases.summary: 邮件列表补丁评审测试中，Opus 5.5 找到 8/14 个问题，旧版找到 6/14。15.40 与 15.19 美元均为订阅使用的 API 等价费用，因此新版并非这组里绝对最便宜。
cases.summary_en: In a mailing-list patch-review test, Opus 5.5 finds 8 of 14 issues versus 6 for Opus 5. The $15.40 and $15.19 figures are API-equivalent estimates for subscription usage, so the newer model is not strictly cheaper here.
cases.author: gwd

cases.title: 游戏项目的复杂 bug 调试
cases.summary: 作者短暂试用 Opus 5.5 调试游戏项目，自述多项复杂 bug 一次解决。帖子没有公开具体问题集或复现步骤，应保留为个人早期使用反馈。
cases.summary_en: After a quick trial on a game project, the author reports solving several complex bugs in one attempt. No public issue set or reproduction steps are provided, so this remains an early personal usage report.
cases.author: ieie3366

cases.title: MacBook Pro 的 SVG 评测
cases.summary: Playcode 分享自家的 MacBook Pro SVG benchmark，称 Opus 5.5 在达到满意结果时成本表现较好，并已设为默认模型。这是工具方自报及产品推广。
cases.summary_en: Playcode shares its MacBook Pro SVG benchmark, reports favorable cost for a good result, and says Opus 5.5 is now its default model. This is a tool provider’s own evaluation and promotion.
cases.author: ianberdin

cases.title: 把完整任务交给模型
cases.summary: 官方指南建议先定义完成条件与汇报时机，再交接完整任务；不必重复要求“认真思考”，长任务后检查继续推进所需信息。帖子附完整 playbook。
cases.summary_en: The official guide recommends defining completion and check-in points before handing over a whole task, dropping redundant thinking instructions, and checking what is needed after a long run. A full playbook is linked.
cases.author: @ClaudeDevs

cases.title: 100 个创意 HTML 的耗时与成本补充
cases.title_en: Cost and duration of 100 creative HTML files
cases.summary: 作者补充百个 HTML 实验：xHigh 用时 1 小时 2 分、消耗五小时额度约 75%，标示成本 482.63 美元；此数字是帖子统计口径，不等于已核验实际支付。
cases.summary_en: The creator adds xHigh metrics for the 100-HTML experiment: 1h 2m, about 75% of a five-hour allowance, and a stated $482.63 cost; this is not verified billing.
cases.author: @MiaAI_lab

cases.title: 精简旧版模型写的文档
cases.title_en: Simplifying prose from an older model
cases.summary: 作者要求清理旧版 Opus 写的文档，并展示标题前后对照：冗长说明被改成 Scope、Status 等直接表述。案例聚焦实际编辑结果，不代表所有文章风格都已改善。
cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 to clean up a document written by an older Opus and shows before-and-after headings, including shorter labels such as Scope and Status. The evidence is this specific editing result.
cases.author: @housecor

cases.title: Khan Academy 的 PR 评审机器人
cases.summary: 团队把内部 PR review bot 从 Opus 5 换到 5.5，作者报告成本下降 50%、工具调用下降 34%、执行时间下降 62%，未见质量下降。数字来自单团队观察。
cases.summary_en: After switching an internal PR review bot from Opus 5 to 5.5, the author reports 50% lower cost, 34% fewer tool calls and 62% less execution time without a quality decrease. These are one team’s observations.
cases.author: @jeresig

cases.title: Next.js 的三模型同分测试
cases.title_en: A three-way tie on Next.js evals
cases.summary: Vercel 负责人报告新一轮 Next.js evals：Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Sol 和 Fable 5.1 均为 97%，Grok 4.7 为 94%。同分结果不能解读为 Opus 全面领先。
cases.summary_en: Vercel’s lead reports fresh Next.js evals: Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Fable 5.1 all score 97%, with Grok 4.7 at 94%. This is a tie on this evaluation, not evidence of universal superiority.
cases.author: @rauchg

cases.title: ARC-AGI 推理与单题成本
cases.title_en: ARC-AGI scores and cost per task
cases.summary: ARC Prize 发布验证结果：ARC-AGI-2 为 93.3%、每题 0.41 美元；ARC-AGI-1 为 98.5%、每题 0.16 美元。成绩与成本只适用于该机构报告的评测条件。
cases.summary_en: ARC Prize reports verified results of 93.3% at $0.41 per task on ARC-AGI-2 and 98.5% at $0.16 on ARC-AGI-1. Scores and costs apply to the evaluator’s reported conditions.
cases.author: @arcprize

cases.title: 在 Apple Watch 上指挥 Agent
cases.summary: 作者称向模型描述新手表后，一小时内做出 Apple Watch 应用，显示 Herdr Agent 的工作状态并支持语音下达指令。应用是使用自述，帖子开头的 RSI 猜测不作为事实。
cases.summary_en: The author says an hour of exploration produced an Apple Watch app that displays working Herdr agents and accepts dictated commands. This is a reported application outcome; the post’s separate RSI speculation is not established fact.
cases.author: @AlexFinn

cases.title: 切换 effort 时保留提示缓存
cases.title_en: Keeping the prompt cache when switching effort
cases.summary: Claude Code 员工说明，在 v2.1.280 及以上版本中，Opus 5.5 会话中途切换 effort 不会破坏 prompt cache。适用于该工具和版本条件。
cases.summary_en: A Claude Code team member explains that changing Opus 5.5 effort mid-session preserves the prompt cache in Claude Code v2.1.280 or later. The guidance is specific to that tool and version range.
cases.author: @lydiahallie

cases.title: Paint 绘图的交互方式对比
cases.title_en: Comparing how models draw in Paint
cases.summary: 作者让两模型在 Paint 画老板肖像再用 Magnific MCP 动画，但称 Opus 采用了不符合要求的捷径。附带视频明确展示 ChatGPT 对照结果，不能当作 Opus 成功演示。
cases.summary_en: The author asks both models to draw a portrait in Paint and animate it with Magnific MCP, but says Opus takes a shortcut instead of the requested interaction. The attached video explicitly shows the ChatGPT comparison output.
cases.author: @matiass

cases.title: Next.js 成功率与平均成本
cases.title_en: Next.js success rate and average cost
cases.summary: Next.js 官方报告 Opus 5.5 达到 97% 成功率，与 Sol、Fable 5.1 持平，并称它在这三者中平均成本最低。帖子链接完整榜单，这是框架特定的评测结果。
cases.summary_en: Next.js reports a 97% success rate for Opus 5.5, tied with Sol and Fable 5.1, and the lowest average cost among those three. The linked leaderboard covers this framework-specific evaluation.
cases.author: @nextjs

cases.title: 视觉检测、提取和推理的成本对照
cases.title_en: Vision detection, extraction and reasoning results
cases.summary: 评测者继续公布Opus 5.5视觉结果：对Fable检测提升11.84个百分点、推理提升12.80个百分点，估算成本降60%；对Sol也给提取和推理差值，整体仍落后Astra。
cases.summary_en: The evaluator reports Opus 5.5 gains over Fable in detection and reasoning, an estimated 60% cost reduction, and gains over Sol, while still ranking below Astra overall.
cases.author: @skalskip92

cases.title: 四个 3D 场景的画面与费用
cases.title_en: Visual detail and cost across four 3D scenes
cases.summary: TestingCatalog 转述 AI/ML API 的四场景生成测试，包含动画鱼群。Opus 合计 4.37 美元，Sol 为 0.34 美元；更细致的画面是原测试方的判断，工具条件需随原帖阅读。
cases.summary_en: TestingCatalog relays AI/ML API’s four-scene generation test, including an animated fish school. Reported totals are $4.37 for Opus and $0.34 for Sol; the richer-render judgment comes from that original test.
cases.author: @testingcatalog

cases.title: 纸笔界面与 Earthrise 重现
cases.title_en: A paper-like interface and an Earthrise recreation
cases.summary: 作者评论案例串中的两个作品：纸笔风格的 Claude Code 界面，以及用公开数据重现 Earthrise 的演示。这是具体作品的二手反馈，并非评论者自己制作。
cases.summary_en: The author comments on two works in a case-study thread: a pen-and-paper-style Claude Code interface and an Earthrise recreation built from public data. This is secondhand feedback, not a claim of personal authorship.
cases.author: @Parsats_eth

cases.title: 高风险请求的拒绝与回退
cases.title_en: A refusal after a safeguard-triggered fallback
cases.summary: 截图展示越权安全请求触发 Opus 5.5 的 cyber 防护，随后由 Opus 4.8 接手并拒绝。没有发生实际攻击，也不能把回退模型的最终回答全部归给 Opus 5.5。
cases.summary_en: The screenshot shows an unauthorized security request triggering Opus 5.5’s cyber safeguard, followed by a fallback to Opus 4.8 and a refusal. No attack is carried out, and the final answer comes from the fallback model.
cases.author: @mehulmpt

cases.title: 生成 Interaction Calculus 规则
cases.summary: 领域作者自述 Opus 5.5 能写出 Interaction Calculus 的语法和规则细节，并给出可核对的项目名称。帖子中的 Bend 自举重写仍只是后续计划，不列为已完成成果。
cases.summary_en: The domain’s author reports that Opus 5.5 reproduces detailed Interaction Calculus grammar and rules and names a project for comparison. Rewriting Bend in itself appears only as a future idea, not a completed result.
cases.author: @VictorTaelin

cases.title: 刷新 T3 Code 的模型缓存
cases.summary: T3 Code 团队说明无需更新应用即可使用新模型，并给出强制刷新模型目录的方法：关闭应用、清理指定模型清单缓存、重新启动。这是接入后的维护教程。
cases.summary_en: The T3 Code team says no app update is needed and explains how to force a model-list refresh: close the app, clear the specified model-manifest caches and restart. This is integration-maintenance guidance.
cases.author: @jullerino

cases.title: 复盘项目与 Agent 会话历史
cases.title_en: Reviewing project files and agent-session history
cases.summary: 六步教程将项目文件和本地会话作为输入，找出重复纠正与失败，再核对当前代码、审查计划、实施测试并保存改进。帖子提供提示词，未宣称这套改造已执行成功。
cases.summary_en: A six-step tutorial combines project files and local sessions to find repeated corrections and failures, check the current code, review a plan, test changes and save improvements. It supplies a prompt, not a verified implementation report.
cases.author: @shannholmberg

cases.title: ProgramBench 多 Agent 的速度
cases.summary: 作者分析系统卡中的 ProgramBench 结果：多 Agent 更快到达单 Agent 相近的结果，同时指出只用了 200 道题中的 166 道。应保留样本覆盖限制。
cases.summary_en: The author discusses system-card results where multiple agents reach similar outcomes to a single agent more quickly, while noting that only 166 of 200 ProgramBench tasks were used. That coverage limit matters.
cases.author: @jyangballin

cases.title: 100 个 Agent 协作解题
cases.summary: ProgramBench 相关作者分享 Opus 5.5 模型卡中的百 Agent 协作评测。帖子确认了具体任务集与协作规模，但关于未来并发机制的讨论仍是设想。
cases.summary_en: A ProgramBench contributor highlights a model-card evaluation of 100 agents coordinating on the benchmark. The task suite and scale are concrete; the post’s discussion of future concurrency mechanisms remains speculative.
cases.author: @18jeffreyma

cases.title: CyScenarioBench 的十题子集
cases.summary: Irregular 报告其多阶段安全基准的 10 题子集被用于评测：Opus 5.5 平均解题率 67.6%，Mythos 5.1 为 61.7%，Opus 5 为 53.0%。这是评测方公布的特定子集结果。
cases.summary_en: Irregular reports that a ten-challenge subset of its multi-stage cyber benchmark yields a 67.6% average solve rate for Opus 5.5, versus 61.7% for Mythos 5.1 and 53.0% for Opus 5. These are evaluator-reported subset results.
cases.author: @Irregular

cases.title: Ramp 的会计任务评测
cases.summary: Ramp 团队披露提前访问，并在自家 Accounting Bench 上实测 Opus 5.5。其报告称表现接近 Fable 5.1，成本低 61%、速度快 1.7 倍；不能外推到所有会计工作。
cases.summary_en: Ramp discloses early access and a run on its Accounting Bench. The team reports performance close to Fable 5.1 at 61% lower cost and 1.7× the speed; this does not establish the same gains for all accounting work.
cases.author: @RampLabs

cases.title: Runescape Bench 的得分与费用
cases.summary: 作者报告 Opus 5.5 在 Runescape Bench 中得分第二，仅次于 Astra，费用约为其三分之一。这里是游戏任务基准结果，不等同于真实玩家体验或所有游戏开发能力。
cases.summary_en: The author reports Opus 5.5 in second place behind Astra on Runescape Bench at roughly one-third of the price. This is a game-task benchmark result, not a measure of every gameplay or development scenario.
cases.author: @maxbittker

cases.title: Harvey 的法律任务评测
cases.summary: Harvey 报告隐私与网络安全、初创企业与风投、资本市场等法律任务较 Opus 5 改善；帖子没有披露具体分数或个案。
cases.summary_en: Harvey reports gains over Opus 5 in privacy and cybersecurity, emerging companies and venture capital, and capital markets, without disclosing individual cases or scores.
cases.author: @harvey

cases.title: Every 的写作与知识工作试用
cases.summary: Every 报告写作可读性分数为 68.42，但仍会埋没重点，部分知识工作超过十分钟超时；这些是早期内部试用结果。
cases.summary_en: Every reports a readability score of 68.42 but buried main points, plus some knowledge-work timeouts beyond ten minutes in early internal testing.
cases.author: @danshipper

cases.title: Three.js 鹈鹕骑单车
cases.summary: 作者用 Three.js 制作骑单车的鹈鹕来试用 Opus 5.5，并附上结果；没有公开运行测试或性能数据。
cases.summary_en: The creator tries Opus 5.5 with a Three.js pelican riding a bike and shares the result, without publishing tests or performance measurements.
cases.author: @addyosmani

cases.title: Zapier 的跨工具运营流程评测
cases.summary: Zapier 在 657 项真实业务流程上报告总体 40%，运营任务 Max 为 62%、Low 为 48%；示例是先在 Slack 找供应商抵扣规则，再处理账目与付款。
cases.summary_en: Zapier reports 40% overall across 657 workflows, with Ops at 62% Max and 48% Low; an example finds vendor-credit rules in Slack before ledger and payment work.
cases.author: @wadefoster

cases.title: CodeRabbit 的代码审查管线评测
cases.summary: CodeRabbit 报告 80 个已知问题中发现 51 个、13 个难例中发现 10 个，并发现 Cal.com 重试计数竞态；同时多用约 50% token 且漏掉基线发现的 9 个问题。
cases.summary_en: CodeRabbit reports 51 of 80 known bugs and 10 of 13 harder cases, including a Cal.com retry race, but about 50% more tokens and nine bugs missed versus its baseline.
cases.author: @coderabbitai

cases.title: Intelligence Index 与任务成本拆解
cases.title_en: Intelligence Index and cost per task
cases.summary: Artificial Analysis报告Opus 5.5在其Intelligence Index居首，并在后续说明max每任务5.98美元，接近Opus 5的5.86美元；更多token本会增加费用，但基础价与缓存折扣抵消了部分增幅。所有结果和成本属于评测方协议下的报告。
cases.summary_en: Artificial Analysis reports an Intelligence Index lead for Opus 5.5 and later breaks down its $5.98 cost per task at max, close to Opus 5's $5.86. Higher token usage is offset partly by base-price and cache-read discounts; findings apply to the evaluator's protocol.
cases.author: @ArtificialAnlys

cases.title: Peated 数据整理与 Junior 迁移
cases.title_en: Peated analysis and a Junior migration
cases.summary: 早期体验者在不知道具体模型身份时，用它做 Peated 数据分析整理及 Junior 迁移；反馈为定性观察，没有量化质量指标。
cases.summary_en: An early tester used the unnamed model for Peated data analysis and curation plus a Junior migration, sharing qualitative impressions rather than measured quality.
cases.author: @zeeg

cases.title: Box 复杂工作评测
cases.summary: Box 报告自有复杂工作评测中，Opus 5.5 比 Opus 5 快 30%、使用约三分之一 token、回答短 42%，同时保持准确性；属于平台自测。
cases.summary_en: Box reports 30% faster output, roughly one-third the tokens and 42% shorter answers than Opus 5 while maintaining accuracy in its own evaluation.
cases.author: @Box

cases.title: 迁移应用代码并审计提示
cases.title_en: Migrating app code and auditing prompts
cases.summary: 教程展示在 Claude Code 使用 /claude-api migrate 更新应用代码，再通过 prompt-audit 检查 skills 和提示是否适合新模型。
cases.summary_en: The tutorial demonstrates /claude-api migrate for application updates and prompt-audit for checking skills and prompts in Claude Code.
cases.author: @RLanceMartin

cases.title: 把 HAProxy 从 C 迁移到 Rust
cases.title_en: Porting HAProxy from C to Rust
cases.summary: Anthropic 团队成员报告两模型均通过几乎全部 HAProxy 测试，Opus 5.5 用时 9.5 小时、Fable 5.1 用时 12 小时，前者成本低 51%；未独立复现。
cases.summary_en: An Anthropic team member reports near-complete test passes for both models, with Opus 5.5 taking 9.5 hours versus 12 for Fable 5.1 at 51% lower cost.
cases.author: @bcherny

cases.title: Perplexity Computer 的 WANDR 评测
cases.summary: 平台报告 Opus 5.5 在 WANDR 得到 0.610、单任务 4.13 美元，成本比 Fable 5.1 低 67.6%；结果只代表该评测设置。
cases.summary_en: Perplexity reports a 0.610 WANDR score at $4.13 per task, 67.6% lower cost than Fable 5.1, within its own evaluation setup.
cases.author: @perplexity_ai

cases.title: 从 Claude 视角制作定格动画
cases.title_en: A stop-motion view through Claude’s eyes
cases.summary: 作者要求制作从 Claude 视角观看世界的定格动画，并说明视频均由 Opus 生成；引用帖保存了成片来源。
cases.summary_en: The creator requests a stop-motion view of the world through Claude’s eyes and credits Opus for the video; the quoted post preserves the original clip.
cases.author: @devteamdrew

cases.title: 一次提示设计开发页脚
cases.title_en: Designing and building a website footer
cases.summary: 作者展示网站页脚，称设计与开发由 Opus 5.5 一次完成；没有公开兼容性或无障碍测试。
cases.summary_en: The creator shares a footer designed and developed in one Opus 5.5 pass, without publishing compatibility or accessibility tests.
cases.author: @stretchcloud

cases.title: Lovable 的构建与修复评测
cases.summary: Lovable 报告从零构建和代码修复维持原有质量、在既有代码库上最多减少 48% 步骤，并改善自检；数据限于平台自己的测试。
cases.summary_en: Lovable reports maintained quality in new builds and iterative fixes, up to 48% fewer steps on existing codebases, and better self-checking in its own tests.
cases.author: @Lovable

cases.title: 用 Python 模拟画家的笔触
cases.summary: 作者用约 7,500 行 Python 标准库代码逐像素绘画，模拟多种画风，并说明没有调用图像模型或现成绘画软件。
cases.summary_en: The creator describes pixel-by-pixel paintings from about 7,500 lines of Python standard-library code, without an image model or packaged art software.
cases.author: @jkeatn

cases.title: 水下哥特式塔楼 Shader
cases.summary: 作者沿用此前的塔楼场景提示，展示 Opus 5.5 的 Shader 版本，并提到破损塔楼细节；这是创作演示及个人比较。
cases.summary_en: The author reuses an earlier tower-scene prompt and shares the Opus 5.5 shader, noting broken-tower details as a personal comparison.
cases.author: @emollick

cases.title: 从想法、计划到交互原型
cases.title_en: From product ideas to interactive prototypes
cases.summary: 作者描述将产品想法整理成单页计划、交互产物和原型，并结合子代理、客户反馈表和语音编辑；这是产品团队的实际使用自述。
cases.summary_en: A product-team member describes one-page plans, interactive artifacts and prototypes, supported by subagents, customer-feedback tables and voice editing.
cases.author: @frankdotlee

cases.title: Shotbase 发布视频
cases.summary: 作者用 HyperFrames 为 Shotbase 制作发布视频，称一个提示、不到 20 分钟得到成片；时长为作者自述。
cases.summary_en: The creator uses HyperFrames for a Shotbase launch video and reports one prompt and less than 20 minutes of work.
cases.author: @Miguel07Code

cases.title: Max 设置下的 SVG 手柄
cases.title_en: An SVG controller at Max effort
cases.summary: 作者展示使用 Opus 5.5 Max 生成的 SVG 游戏手柄；原帖未提供交互功能或运行测试。
cases.summary_en: The creator shares an SVG game controller generated with Opus 5.5 Max, without claiming tested interactive behavior.
cases.author: @hakmgpt

cases.title: Mario Kart 风格赛车
cases.summary: 作者展示 Opus 5.5 制作的 Mario Kart 风格赛车结果；原帖没有公开实现栈或测试细节。
cases.summary_en: The creator shows a Mario Kart-style result made with Opus 5.5, without detailing the stack or tests.
cases.author: @cherry_mx_reds

cases.title: G-Wagon 车辆三维建模
cases.summary: 作者在 Claude Code 的 Max 设置下生成 G-Wagon 三维车辆模型，展示包括车标在内的细节；质量比较属于主观反馈。
cases.summary_en: The author uses Max effort in Claude Code to produce a G-Wagon model and highlights its logo details; quality comparisons are subjective.
cases.author: @srikanthvaluri

cases.title: ViktorBench 的 Slack 与 Teams 任务
cases.title_en: ViktorBench tasks from Slack and Teams
cases.summary: Viktor 用来自 Slack 和 Teams 的真实委派任务评测，报告 Opus 5.5 比 Opus 5 更有用、单任务成本更低；这是平台自有评测。
cases.summary_en: Viktor reports higher usefulness and lower task cost than Opus 5 on its own benchmark of delegated Slack and Teams work.
cases.author: @viktor_com

cases.summary: 作者将原海岸场景变为钓鱼游戏，加入卖鱼、渔具与船零件商店，改用原生 WebGPU；称优化一度从60到100FPS，随后新功能吃掉多数增益，仍有瑕疵。
cases.summary_en: The author adds fishing, fish sales and tackle/boat-part shops to the coastal scene and switches to native WebGPU; a reported 60-to-100 FPS gain was mostly spent on new features.
cases.author: @dangreenheck

cases.title: JavaScript 自画像与钢琴配乐
cases.title_en: JavaScript self-portraits with a piano score
cases.summary: 作者展示 Opus 5.5 用 JavaScript 绘制自画像并创作钢琴配乐的短片；没有提供独立运行或音频制作管线验证。
cases.summary_en: The creator credits Opus 5.5 for JavaScript self-portraits and a composed piano score, sharing the combined video without an independently reproduced pipeline.
cases.author: @kevin_t_ngo

cases.title: 《I Will Never Be a Human》两分钟动画
cases.title_en: A two-minute I Will Never Be a Human episode
cases.summary: 作者在此前模型自述动画基础上继续迭代，要求按会话制作两分钟完整篇章。引用的前作以 JavaScript 笔触绘制每帧；本帖展示后续成片。
cases.summary_en: The creator iterates on an earlier self-narrative animation and requests a full two-minute episode based on the session. The cited earlier work rendered frames with JavaScript brush strokes.
cases.author: @shfred0

cases.title: 双路 4K UDP 视频流原型
cases.summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 完成基于 Pyrowave 的双路 4K UDP 传输原型，由 M1 Mac mini 接收；展示是作者实际观看反馈，未提供系统化延迟或丢帧测量。
cases.summary_en: The author reports a Pyrowave-based prototype sending two 4K streams over UDP to an M1 Mac mini. The post offers viewing impressions, not systematic latency or dropped-frame measurements.
cases.author: @evadne

cases.title: 用代码制作 13 分钟音乐视频
cases.summary: 作者展示以 Tool 音乐为主题的 13 分钟视频，并称其完全由代码制作；帖子未公开渲染细节或素材授权信息。
cases.summary_en: The author shares a 13-minute Tool music video and says it was produced entirely with code; rendering details are not provided.
cases.author: @cube__lol

cases.title: 照片到三维模型的迭代对照
cases.summary: 作者用同一张照片到三维模型的长期任务，对比 Astra 数天自动研究循环与 Opus 5.5 约六小时工作后的结果；未提供统一评分，不能从配图推导精度结论。
cases.summary_en: The author compares several days of an Astra autoresearch loop with about six hours of Opus 5.5 on a longstanding photo-to-3D task, without standardized accuracy scores.
cases.author: @xpasky

cases.title: Analog 代码库模块化重构
cases.summary: 作者报告一次调用中完成 Analog 代码库重构，包括 67 次工具调用、327 个新文件和 3.4 万多行新增代码；“全部可用”尚未独立验证。
cases.summary_en: The author reports one refactoring session with 67 tool calls, 327 new files and over 34,000 added lines, breaking up monoliths. The claim that it all works is not independently verified.
cases.author: @initjean

cases.title: 稀疏注意力架构对照图
cases.summary: 作者与 Opus 5.5 合作可视化四种高效模型架构，比较 YOCO、线性注意力、Engram 与残差设计；技术判断来自作者，图示不是模型架构的独立核验。
cases.summary_en: The author and Opus 5.5 create a comparison of four efficient architectures, covering YOCO, linear attention, Engram and residual designs. The technical claims remain the author’s analysis.
cases.author: @eliebakouch

cases.title: 用 Markdown 交接上下文切换模型
cases.title_en: Carrying project context between models with Markdown
cases.summary: 作者把近期项目 Markdown 交给 Opus 5.5，在更换订阅后继续工作；帖子总结可跨平台维护项目资料的实践，但没有量化迁移效果。
cases.summary_en: The author supplies recent project Markdown files to Opus 5.5 after switching subscriptions and describes a portable context workflow, without a measured productivity result.
cases.author: @DillonLoomis

cases.title: 在自有引擎中制作深海恐怖游戏
cases.title_en: A deep-sea horror game inside a custom engine
cases.summary: 作者只要求在自己引擎能力范围内做游戏，模型制作了带低沉配乐的深海恐怖作品；作者也指出平衡性欠佳、部分体验不公平。
cases.summary_en: Given only the limits of the creator’s engine, Opus 5.5 makes a deep-sea horror game with a drone soundtrack; the creator notes unbalanced and unfair sections.
cases.author: @ggsimm

cases.title: 基于数学的鼠标交互 HTML 实验
cases.summary: 作者沿用要求数学基础、鼠标响应、无外部库的单文件 HTML 提示测试 Opus 5.5，并展示结果；后续跨模型比较是作者自己的排序，提示要求不等于逐项验证通过。
cases.summary_en: The author applies a prompt for a mathematical, mouse-responsive, self-contained HTML page without external libraries to Opus 5.5. Prompt requirements are not independently verified features.
cases.author: @MiaAI_lab

cases.title: Backrooms 风格的 30 秒影像
cases.title_en: Thirty seconds of Backrooms found footage
cases.summary: 作者在 Medium 设置下要求表现 AI 测试图像失败结果所处的 Backrooms 场景，并分享 30 秒成片；具体渲染与素材管线未说明。
cases.summary_en: At Medium effort, the creator requests found footage set among malformed AI-art test results in the Backrooms and shares a 30-second video; the rendering pipeline is unspecified.
cases.author: @goodside

cases.title: 用鼠标与 JS Paint 临摹蒙娜丽莎
cases.title_en: Painting the Mona Lisa through browser controls
cases.summary: 作者让模型先找参考图，再通过 Cowork 与 Claude in Chrome 操作 JS Paint，报告绘画用时约 20 分钟；随后另要求制作展示鼠标操作的回顾视频。
cases.summary_en: Using Cowork and Claude in Chrome, the author asks for a reference search and mouse-driven JS Paint recreation, reports about 20 minutes of drawing, then requests a separate process video.
cases.author: @ehsanik

cases.title: 改进 Astra 制作的 OVER TIME 游戏
cases.title_en: Polishing an Astra-built OVER TIME game
cases.summary: 作者把原先用 Astra 制作的 OVER TIME 射击游戏交给 Opus 5.5 打磨，并展示新版；原版已有风险与收益抉择玩法，提升幅度是作者主观评价。
cases.summary_en: The creator uses Opus 5.5 to polish the Astra-built OVER TIME shooter and shares a new version. Its risk-versus-reward loop predates this pass; the quality gain is subjective.
cases.author: @akakuma0219

cases.title: 一分钟的模型自述短片
cases.summary: 作者在 Extra 设置下要求制作一部关于模型自身生活、令人触动的一分钟视频，并附结果；不将这种创作叙事视为模型具有真实生活或感受。
cases.summary_en: At Extra effort, the creator requests a poignant one-minute video about the model’s life and shares the result; the narrative is a creative framing.
cases.author: @goodside

cases.title: 复查另一模型的代码改动
cases.title_en: Reviewing changes made by another model
cases.summary: 作者在 GPT-6 Sol 的结果中发现回归后，让 Opus 5.5 复查并报告多个问题；原帖没有公开差异或测试结果，Excel 格式问题属于对 Sol 的反馈。
cases.summary_en: After noticing regressions in GPT-6 Sol’s work, the author reports using Opus 5.5 to identify several issues. No diff or test results are shared; the Excel complaint concerns Sol.
cases.author: @ZryMiller

cases.title: Littlebury 18 洞迷你高尔夫
cases.summary: 作者展示浏览器内运行的 18 洞三维迷你高尔夫和英式模型村，包含风车、火车与城堡吊桥，并称宣传片也由 Opus 制作。
cases.summary_en: The creator presents an 18-hole 3D browser course in a miniature English village, with a windmill, train and drawbridge, and credits Opus for the promotional video too.
cases.author: @_nilni

cases.title: 100 个开放式工程环境评测
cases.summary: GertLabs 作者报告在 100 个开放式编程与工程环境测试 Opus 5.5：单次代码能力较强，但 High effort 下的自有 agent 测试中会提前结束。排名与性能属于该评测设置。
cases.summary_en: A GertLabs evaluator reports strong one-shot coding but premature stopping in a custom agent harness at High effort across 100 open-ended environments; rankings are specific to that setup.
cases.author: @leo_linsky

cases.title: 代码库综合审计发现安全问题
cases.title_en: A broad code audit finds a security issue
cases.summary: 作者给出覆盖安全、性能、无障碍、架构和测试等方面的审计提示，称 Opus 5.5 找到了此前模型漏掉的重要安全问题；漏洞细节未公开。
cases.summary_en: The creator shares an audit prompt spanning security, performance, accessibility and architecture, and reports a significant issue missed by prior models; vulnerability details are withheld.
cases.author: @kentcdodds

cases.title: 项目讲解视频
cases.summary: 作者要求 Opus 5.5 为项目制作讲解视频并展示成片；原帖没有说明项目细节或制作工具。
cases.summary_en: The author shares a project explainer made with Opus 5.5, without describing the project or the production tools in detail.
cases.author: @vibe_walking

cases.title: 修改法律申请书与额度消耗
cases.title_en: Editing a legal petition and tracking quota use
cases.summary: 作者称让 Opus 5.5 修改此前已核对的申请书，任务最终完成但消耗了 56% 使用额度；这是单次使用记录，不代表法律质量已获验证。
cases.summary_en: The author says edits to an already reviewed petition succeeded but consumed 56% of their usage allowance; this is a single report, not legal-quality validation.
cases.author: @marcusaraujobhz

cases.title: 歌词与视频分工的音乐短片
cases.title_en: A music video with separate lyric and video models
cases.summary: 帖子将《Great Goatse of Gnosis》的视频归给 Opus 5.5、歌词归给 Opus 3；保留两个模型的分工，不把歌词也算作 5.5 的产物。
cases.summary_en: The post credits Opus 5.5 for the Great Goatse of Gnosis video and Opus 3 for its lyrics; those contributions remain separate.
cases.author: @Shoalst0ne

cases.title: 费用管理应用宣传片
cases.summary: 作者用一个提示要求为自己的费用管理应用制作宣传视频，并附上结果；单次提示完成是作者自述。
cases.summary_en: The creator shares a promotional video for their expense-tracking app and says it came from one prompt; the production workflow is not detailed.
cases.author: @gonahmias

cases.title: 从竞品网址梳理营销漏斗
cases.summary: 作者称只提供竞品 URL 并要求可视化营销漏斗，约一分钟得到配图结果；未披露数据核验过程。
cases.summary_en: The author reports supplying a competitor URL and receiving a funnel visualization in about a minute; the underlying data was not independently checked.
cases.author: @shikamarurobo

cases.title: 火柴人动画对照
cases.summary: 作者展示 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Luna 的火柴人动画对照；帖子未给出统一评分标准，不据此断言哪一个更强。
cases.summary_en: The post compares stick-figure animations from Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna, without a standardized score or an independently verified winner.
cases.author: @ForwardEditor

cases.title: 用代码制作 AI 加速主义短片
cases.summary: 作者要求制作支持 AI 加速发展的剪辑，并说明成片完全使用代码制作；帖子附视频，未披露具体渲染工具。
cases.summary_en: The creator requested a pro-AI acceleration edit and says the attached video was made entirely with code; the rendering stack is unspecified.
cases.author: @holytrinity

cases.title: OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的像素画讽刺场景
cases.title_en: A pixel-art satire of OpenAI and Anthropic
cases.summary: 作者分享署名 Opus 5.5 的 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 像素画动画，画面用办公室与技术圈梗作幽默表达；未说明生成工具，也不能把其中的品牌讽刺当作事实描述。
cases.summary_en: The author credits Opus 5.5 for a pixel-art animation depicting OpenAI and Anthropic offices through technical in-jokes. Production tools are unspecified, and its brand satire should not be read as factual reporting.
cases.author: @DotCSV

cases.title: 从20分钟播客挑选并编辑短片
cases.summary: 作者介绍 Opus 5.5 与 After Effects 根据约20分钟播客音频挑选高光并编辑短片的流程；帖子未公开完整提示、实际费用或人工修改范围，低成本说法未验证。
cases.summary_en: The post describes Opus 5.5 and After Effects selecting highlights from roughly 20 minutes of podcast audio and editing a short. The full prompt, actual cost, and manual intervention are unspecified.
cases.author: @Fujin_Metaverse

cases.title: 汉堡模拟器的三模型时间与费用对照
cases.title_en: Comparing three models on a burger simulator
cases.summary: 作者通过 AIML API 给三个模型相同第一人称汉堡游戏任务，自报 Opus 5.5 为1:23:33、13.13美元，Sol 为55:57、3.37美元，Luna 为1:09:37、0.28美元；视觉评价及费用均限于这次作者实验。
cases.summary_en: The author uses AIML API for the same first-person burger-game task and reports Opus 5.5 at 1:23:33/$13.13, Sol at 55:57/$3.37, and Luna at 1:09:37/$0.28. Visual judgments and costs apply only to this reported experiment.
cases.author: @noclipepe

cases.title: 多轮制作 Social SDK 发布视频
cases.title_en: An iterative Social SDK launch-video workflow
cases.summary: Social SDK 作者分享发布视频流程：主要使用 Opus 5.5，难点交给 Fable 5.1，结合 HyperFrames、现有代码和动画组件；作者强调逐段指定内容并多次迭代，不能当成一句话自动出片。
cases.summary_en: Social SDK’s creator describes using mostly Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 for difficult parts, HyperFrames, project code, and animation components. Each segment was directed and repeatedly revised, rather than produced from one vague instruction.
cases.author: @leodev

cases.title: 蚂蚁守家对抗园丁的游戏比较
cases.summary: Higgsfield 展示 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 制作蚂蚁对抗园丁的3D游戏，比较叶间光线、人物尺度和战斗表现；属于平台宣传对照，没有独立玩法评测。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield compares Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra making a 3D game about an ant defending its home from a gardener, highlighting lighting, scale, and combat. This is a promotional comparison without independent gameplay testing.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: Claude Pop 音乐视频的素材与服务编排
cases.title_en: Planning assets and services for Claude Pop
cases.summary: 二手解读分享 Opus 5.5 制作 Claude Pop 视频所用的长提示，包含参考素材、JavaScript 动画与外部媒体服务安排；12小时是转述耗时，提示里要求的工具不等于已核实的执行记录。
cases.summary_en: A secondary breakdown shares a long prompt for an Opus 5.5 Claude Pop video, covering reference assets, JavaScript animation, and external media services. Twelve hours is a reported duration; requested tools are not a verified execution log.
cases.author: @NickADobos

cases.title: 红熊猫首领的黑白武士游戏
cases.title_en: A monochrome samurai game with a red-panda boss
cases.summary: Higgsfield 称 Opus 5.5 一次提示制作黑白战场、红月与巨型红熊猫首领的武士游戏，并和 Astra 对照；画面与旧草原武士案例不同，但一次完成与可玩程度未独立验证。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield reports a single-prompt samurai game with a monochrome battlefield, red moon, and giant red-panda boss, compared with Astra. It differs from the older grassland demo; the one-prompt claim and playability were not independently verified.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 单个 HTML 实现黑洞太空旅程
cases.title_en: A space journey in one HTML file
cases.summary: Higgsfield 称 Opus 5.5 用一个 index.html 和 Canvas 2D 制作从飞船窗口观看的连续太空旅程，不用图片、视频或外部库；这是平台展示，未独立运行源码。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield reports an Opus 5.5 spaceship-window journey built in one index.html with Canvas 2D, without images, video, or libraries. It is a platform demo; the source was not independently executed.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 按手绘连线匹配人物姓名与颜色
cases.title_en: Matching names and colors in a line drawing
cases.summary: 作者展示 Opus 5.5 medium 对手绘连线图的回答，把姓名沿箭头匹配到不同颜色的人物；已查看截图，但这只是单张视觉题，不能代表通用视觉理解准确率。
cases.summary_en: The post shows Opus 5.5 medium answering a hand-drawn puzzle by tracing names to colored figures along arrows. The screenshot was inspected; one example does not establish general visual-reasoning accuracy.
cases.author: @tenobrus

cases.title: 用动画表现 Claude 学经济学
cases.summary: 作者分享由 Opus 5.5 制作的“Claude 学经济学”动画；帖子没有交代制作工具，也未验证其中经济学表述的准确性。
cases.summary_en: The author shares an Opus 5.5 animation about Claude learning economics. The post does not detail production tools, and the accuracy of its economic explanations was not evaluated.
cases.author: @jack_whitcomb_

cases.title: 护肤品动态广告的镜头对照
cases.summary: Higgsfield 用相同护肤品牌视频任务比较 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 的镜头、光线和产品展示；这是平台推广样片，未公开完整提示或客观广告效果测试。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield compares camera movement, lighting, and product presentation from Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra on the same skincare-video task. These are promotional samples, without a complete prompt or objective advertising test.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: After Effects 唇膏广告对照
cases.summary: Higgsfield 给 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 相同品牌素材，制作配乐同步的20秒 After Effects 唇膏广告；两边采用不同视觉路线，属于平台推广比较，并未证明任一方案更有效。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield gives Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra the same brand assets for a 20-second, music-timed After Effects lip-balm ad. Their visual approaches differ, but this promotional comparison does not establish advertising effectiveness.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 重建90年代唱片店 Play De Record
cases.title_en: Recreating the Play De Record shop
cases.summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 一次提示重建了可探索的 Play De Record 唱片店，并使用 Blender，附桌面试玩链接；音乐来源连作者也未说明，不能视为模型原创配乐。
cases.summary_en: The author reports a single-prompt, explorable recreation of the 1990s Play De Record shop using Opus 5.5 and Blender, with a desktop demo link. The music’s source is unspecified and should not be treated as model-composed.
cases.author: @illscience

cases.title: 把奔马视频帧堆叠成4D立方体
cases.title_en: Stacking a galloping horse into a 4D cube
cases.summary: Higgsfield 展示 Opus 5.5 将一段奔马视频逐帧堆叠成4D立方体，让同一匹马的不同时刻同时出现；素材来自原视频，属于平台自营效果展示。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield shows Opus 5.5 stacking frames from one horse video into a 4D cube, making different moments visible together. The source is existing footage, and the demonstration promotes the platform.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: JavaScript 绘制世界的过去与未来
cases.title_en: Painting past and future in JavaScript
cases.summary: Higgsfield 展示 Opus 5.5 用 JavaScript 绘制世界过去与未来的画面，称未用图片或视频模型；属于平台自营的代码绘画展示，制作细节未独立复核。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield presents Opus 5.5 drawing scenes of the world’s past and future in JavaScript, reportedly without image or video models. This is a promotional code-art demo, and the production details were not independently checked.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 用代码制作致敬独立开发者的动画
cases.title_en: A coded animation celebrating solo builders
cases.summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 制作庆祝独立开发者的动画影片，并称仅用代码，没有调用 AI 视频或音乐模型；原帖未交代渲染实现或验证制作过程。
cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 for an animated film celebrating solo builders and says it uses only code, without AI video or music models. Rendering details and the production process were not independently verified.
cases.author: @andresmatte

cases.title: 哥特式飞船棋子扩展为国际象棋应用
cases.title_en: Gothic spaceship pieces become a chess app
cases.summary: 作者原本要求 Opus 5.5 做哥特式飞船棋具，得到 JavaScript/WebGL 象棋应用，含飞行棋子、历史棋局展示与引擎；功能来自作者描述，未独立测试棋力或规则完整性。
cases.summary_en: Asked for a gothic spaceship chess set, Opus 5.5 reportedly builds a JavaScript/WebGL chess app with flying pieces, historical games, and an engine. Features are author-reported; engine strength and rule completeness were not tested.
cases.author: @sdmat123

cases.title: 海岸特洛伊木马的模型对照
cases.title_en: Comparing a Trojan Horse on the shore
cases.summary: Higgsfield 要求 Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 表现海岸上的特洛伊木马，并分享对照结果；制作工具细节和客观质量指标未公开，属于平台推广展示。
cases.summary_en: Higgsfield asks Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra to depict a Trojan Horse on a shore and shares the comparison. Tool details and objective quality metrics are absent; this is a platform promotional demonstration.
cases.author: @higgsfield_ai

cases.title: 把跳远过程展开为时空体

cases.summary_en: The platform combines a Schindelar3D Gaussian Splat with Astra and Opus 5.5 game development, Blender assets and splat relighting in ArrivalSpace. Individual model roles are not separated.
cases.author: @arrival_space_

cases.title: 六边形岛屿上的蜜蜂游戏
cases.title_en: A bee game on a hexagonal island
cases.summary: 作者用Nuxt、TresJS与Opus 5.5制作蜜蜂游戏，描述采蜜、结交野蜂、建蜂巢和探索迷雾区域。
cases.summary_en: The author builds a bee game with Nuxt, TresJS and Opus 5.5, describing nectar gathering, wild-bee friendships, hive building and mist exploration.
cases.author: @zernonia

cases.title: 为《The Accuser》旧歌配视频
cases.title_en: A video for the earlier song The Accuser
cases.summary: 作者让Opus 5.5为2009年录制的The Accuser制作视频，称未使用外部库或视频模型并运行过夜；歌曲属于原有录音。
cases.summary_en: The author gives Opus 5.5 a song recorded in 2009 and reports an overnight video build without external libraries or video models. The audio is pre-existing.
cases.author: @qiqing

cases.title: 自拍与旧简历制作个人视频
cases.title_en: A personal video from selfies and a résumé
cases.summary: 作者以自拍和旧简历为脚本输入，称Opus 5.5指挥Higgsfield CLI完成换装等视觉处理，单提示生成视频；外部素材工具参与明确保留。
cases.summary_en: The author supplies selfies and an old résumé, reporting that Opus 5.5 directs Higgsfield CLI for costume changes and other visuals from one prompt.
cases.author: @tonylongname

cases.title: 迭代胎儿面部发育教学视频
cases.summary: 作者让Opus 5.5制作胎儿面部发育教学视频，认为初版形状抽象吓人，发布修订版；另引斑马鱼作品仅作过往参照，科学准确性未验证。
cases.summary_en: The author shares a revised Opus 5.5 educational video after finding the first version’s shape abstractions disturbing. Developmental accuracy is not independently verified.
cases.author: @bryancsk

cases.title: 特洛伊木马陶瓶动画对照
cases.summary: 转述者描述Arena对同一提示的Sol与Opus 5.5陶瓶动画比较，称Opus版本出现转台与连续情节；未经独立观看验证，双模型视频不作Opus独占媒体。
cases.summary_en: A secondary account describes Arena’s Sol and Opus 5.5 comparison, reporting an orbiting vase and continuing narrative for Opus. The mixed comparison is retained without exclusive media attribution.
cases.author: @AIBoticssq

cases.title: VulcanBench 四档评测与轨迹公开
cases.summary: 此前受阻的VulcanBench Frontier v4评测已完成四天测试并公开报告和GitHub轨迹；作者发现Medium/High优于更高档，任务特意刁钻，不代表日常任务。
cases.summary_en: After the earlier blocked run, the author completes four days of Frontier v4 tests and publishes results and traces, reporting Medium/High outperforming higher settings on intentionally difficult tasks.
cases.author: @morganlinton

cases.title: IMD 群体的三维浏览器
cases.title_en: A 3D explorer for the IMD swarm
cases.summary: 作者分享用Opus 5.5一次生成的IMD swarm三维浏览页面与公开链接；一次生成和质量为作者评价。
cases.summary_en: The author shares a public 3D explorer for the IMD swarm, reported as a one-shot Opus 5.5 creation.
cases.author: @0xfinne

cases.title: 在 Motion 中制作创始人纪录片
cases.summary: Motion平台让GPT-6制作Sam Altman纪录片、Opus 5.5制作Dario Amodei纪录片；双模型对照不将整段混合媒体归给Opus。
cases.summary_en: Motion asks GPT-6 for a Sam Altman documentary and Opus 5.5 for one about Dario Amodei. This platform comparison does not attribute the combined media entirely to Opus.
cases.author: @motion_so

cases.title: 检索资料制作模型诞生史视频
cases.title_en: Researching and animating a model’s history
cases.summary: 作者让Opus 5.5研究自身发展史，再用eidoverse-video和Three.js制作视频，并在Blender中补做素材；叙事准确性未独立核验。
cases.summary_en: The author reports Opus 5.5 researching its history and making a video with eidoverse-video and Three.js, creating additional assets in Blender.
cases.author: @SkyeSharkie

cases.title: Opus 规划、MiMo 实现图表页面
cases.summary: 作者用Opus 5.5规划，再由MiMo 2.6 Pro实现两页图表及后端，称总花费0.66美元；实现与低价不能全部归给Opus。
cases.summary_en: The author uses Opus 5.5 to plan two chart-heavy pages and a backend, then MiMo 2.6 Pro to implement them, reporting $0.66 in cost.
cases.author: @IcyCortex

cases.title: Poseidia 亚特兰蒂斯岛屿漫游
cases.summary: 作者让Opus 5.5用Three.js构建亚特兰蒂斯遗岛Poseidia及预告片，提供可访问漫游链接；约两小时为作者自述，未来互动设想未当成已实现。
cases.summary_en: The author shares an explorable Atlantis island and trailer made with Opus 5.5 and Three.js in a reported two hours; future imagined features are not claimed as implemented.
cases.author: @DannyLimanseta

cases.title: 跨编程工具比较 Opus 工具调用效率
cases.title_en: Comparing tool-call efficiency across coding agents
cases.summary: 作者在Claude Code与pi-agent等工具中以High设置每组运行30次，对比Opus 5与5.5，报告后者工具调用、轮数及输出token减少；不是单纯价格新闻。
cases.summary_en: The author runs 30 trials per setup at High across Claude Code and pi-agent, comparing Opus 5 and 5.5 and reporting fewer calls, turns and output tokens.
cases.author: @ibragim_bad

cases.title: 意识与物理载体的代码动画
cases.title_en: Animating a view of substrate independence
cases.summary: 作者发布由Opus 5.5用代码动画化的意识载体独立性解说；这是哲学观点的呈现，不将其当作科学定论。
cases.summary_en: The author credits Opus 5.5 with a coded animation about consciousness and substrate independence; it presents an argument rather than established proof.
cases.author: @RifeWithKaiju

cases.title: 为 Suno 歌曲编写水彩渲染视频
cases.title_en: A watercolor renderer for a Suno song
cases.summary: 作者提供Suno歌曲，让Opus 5.5从头写水彩渲染器并依据歌词绘制场景，称不到一小时渲染成片；歌曲来自外部工具。
cases.summary_en: The author supplies a Suno song and reports Opus 5.5 writing a watercolor renderer, drawing lyric-driven scenes and rendering the video in under an hour.
cases.author: @johnknopf

cases.title: 从像素画转向像素特效
cases.title_en: Switching from pixel art to pixel effects
cases.summary: 作者测试Opus 5.5像素画后认为静态效果差，转而按提示制作像素VFX并分享动画；保留负面评价与转向后的主观满意结果。
cases.summary_en: After finding Opus 5.5 pixel-art generation poor, the author shifts to prompted pixel VFX and shares animations, reporting better subjective results.
cases.author: @RealAstropulse

cases.title: 金融公式与跑酷的分屏解说
cases.summary: 作者要求Opus 5.5 Extra制作一分钟视频：右侧旁白讲Black–Scholes公式，左侧播放仿Subway Surfers跑酷；未核验数学或游戏实现。
cases.summary_en: The prompt asks Opus 5.5 Extra for a one-minute video combining a narrated Black–Scholes explanation with a generic Subway Surfers-style game.
cases.author: @goodside

cases.title: 用 Python 改编《终局》卡通
cases.title_en: A Python cartoon of Beckett’s Endgame
cases.summary: 作者用Opus 5.5与数千行Python制作贝克特《终局》的删节卡通，配音由ElevenLabs提供；不是纯模型直接生成全部音视频。
cases.summary_en: The author reports an abridged cartoon adaptation built with Opus 5.5 and thousands of lines of Python, using ElevenLabs voices.
cases.author: @samspike_

cases.title: CORTEX 在 Obsidian 中关联并回忆笔记
cases.title_en: CORTEX links and recalls Obsidian notes
cases.summary: CORTEX用Opus 5.5整理语音备忘、附理由连接相关及反证笔记，再沿图谱引用回答；作者描述14条笔记、4跳检索，数据留为vault内Markdown。
cases.summary_en: CORTEX uses Opus 5.5 to distill voice notes, explain links including counterarguments, and answer through cited graph traversal. The author reports reading 14 notes in four hops.
cases.author: @Shelpid_WI3M

cases.title: 从品牌资料到营销动画的流程
cases.title_en: From brand context to a marketing animation
cases.summary: 作者结合Lunar Creative Library视频说明：Opus 5.5负责分镜、录屏、动画与剪辑，Codex/GPT-6提供缺失图像；先审分镜、低清预览，再按时间码修改。
cases.summary_en: Using a Lunar Creative Library video, the author details storyboarding, capture, animation and editing with Opus 5.5, with Codex/GPT-6 supplying images and timestamped feedback guiding revisions.
cases.author: @shannholmberg

cases.title: 宝可梦绿宝石的漏洞实验
cases.summary: 作者让Opus 5.5与Kimi K3在Pokémon Emerald寻找新漏洞，称两者都构造能将游戏变为俄罗斯方块的连接线传播实验；这是自述测试，不扩展为现实攻击指南。
cases.summary_en: The author reports testing Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3 for novel flaws in Pokémon Emerald, with both producing a link-cable experiment that transforms the game into Tetris.
cases.author: @runsybil

cases.title: 把 IKEA 手册变成三维安装说明
cases.title_en: Turning an IKEA manual into 3D instructions
cases.summary: 作者要求Opus 5.5把IKEA安装手册转换为带旁白的三维教学视频，并发布结果；未独立核验装配步骤。
cases.summary_en: The author shares a narrated 3D instruction video requested from an IKEA assembly manual using Opus 5.5; assembly accuracy is unverified.
cases.author: @deedydas

cases.title: Squad 的单提示产品视频
cases.summary: 作者借用另一位作者的提示，在Squad中让Opus 5.5制作Squad产品视频，自称一次生成；引用提供提示灵感而非本作品归属。
cases.summary_en: Using another creator’s prompt, the author reports making a Squad product video with Opus 5.5 inside Squad in one pass.
cases.author: @pbteja1998

cases.title: Algorithm W 类型推导讲解视频
cases.summary: 作者让Opus 5.5制作Hindley–Milner类型系统中Algorithm W推导过程的视频；教学正确性未独立验证。
cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 to animate Algorithm W type inference in Hindley–Milner systems; correctness has not been independently checked.
cases.author: @Aron_Adler

cases.title: Newsworthy 新闻摄影游戏
cases.summary: 作者展示在实时AI生成城市中先制造事件、再追逐新闻照片的Newsworthy游戏，注明使用Reactor与Opus 5.5。
cases.summary_en: The author presents a game about causing scenes and chasing photos in a live AI-generated city, made with Reactor and Opus 5.5.
cases.author: @vamonke

cases.title: TweetsMash 的书签产品流程视频
cases.summary: 作者用Opus 5.5将真实书签API、HTML帧、Headless Chrome抓取、ffmpeg和Python音乐串成39秒视频，描述经过8轮渲染反馈。
cases.summary_en: The author reports a 39-second video built from real bookmark API data, HTML frames, Headless Chrome capture, ffmpeg and Python music, with eight feedback renders.
cases.author: @code_rams

cases.title: 边滚动边重设计网站
cases.summary: Jev决定布局、文案与风格，Opus 5.5写TSX组件和CSS，按滚动进入视口的区块顺序替换网站；作者称八个区块约20秒，未独立复现。
cases.summary_en: Jev selects layout and style while Opus 5.5 writes TSX and CSS for sections entering the viewport. The author reports eight sections rebuilt in about 20 seconds.
cases.author: @0xMovez

cases.title: 在 Paint 中手绘同一张人像
cases.title_en: Drawing the same portrait in Paint
cases.summary: 作者让GPT-6 Astra与Opus 5.5基于同一照片在Paint中手绘人像；两图分别属于两个模型，未将对照图当作Opus作品展示。
cases.summary_en: The author compares Astra and Opus 5.5 manually drawing a portrait in Paint from the same photo. The two-model comparison is retained as text without attributing both images to Opus.
cases.author: @Y2K_mindset

cases.title: BUZZCORE 的拒单与交易日志
cases.summary: 作者描述Jev负责四项检查、Opus 5.5生成交易资料并管理头寸的BUZZCORE流程，包含证据不足时拒单；67美元至16798美元为未经核实的收益自述。
cases.summary_en: The author describes Jev checks and Opus 5.5 profiling and position management, including a veto for insufficient evidence. The claimed rise from $67 to $16,798 is unverified.
cases.author: @0xTimQ

cases.title: 海鸥、海浪与泡沫实时场景
cases.title_en: A real-time seagull and wave scene
cases.summary: 作者用Opus 5.5与Three.js制作浏览器实时海滨场景，明确ElevenLabs提供声音、Tripo提供海鸥素材；称其在2024款MacBook Pro运行。
cases.summary_en: The author describes a browser scene made with Opus 5.5 and Three.js, with ElevenLabs sound and Tripo seagulls, running on a 2024 MacBook Pro.
cases.author: @gruberbuilds

cases.title: Dictation Key 0.5.0 发布视频
cases.title_en: A launch video for Dictation Key 0.5.0
cases.summary: 作者让Opus 5.5制作离线听写应用Dictation Key的完整发布视频；离线转写与清理是应用功能，不等于模型本身离线运行。
cases.summary_en: The author credits Opus 5.5 with the launch video for Dictation Key. Offline dictation and cleanup describe the app, not offline operation of the model.
cases.author: @pranjalsoni_

cases.title: jevmem 的记忆保存判定对照
cases.summary: 作者转述 jevmem 在66轮保留测试中比较Jev与Opus 5.5：保存判定为65/66与64/66；Opus编程、Jev筛选记忆，测试未衡量后续编程收益。
cases.summary_en: A secondary report compares Jev and Opus 5.5 on 66 held-out memory decisions: 65/66 versus 64/66. Opus codes while Jev filters memories; downstream coding gains were not measured.
cases.author: @mika_systems

cases.title: 快速克隆多个应用未成功
cases.summary: 作者回答软件复刻失败问题，称未能用 Opus 5.5 快速克隆 Uber、iOS、iFood 和 PicPay，原因尚不清楚；缺少日志与功能级细节。
cases.summary_en: The author reports being unable to quickly clone Uber, iOS, iFood and PicPay with Opus 5.5, without logs or a diagnosed cause.
cases.author: @samsantosb

cases.title: Borderlands 2 SDK 的侧项目
cases.summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 和 Borderlands 2 SDK 在约一天半中推进朋友提出的侧项目，并称尚无明显阻碍；具体功能未完整披露。
cases.summary_en: The author reports roughly a day and a half of work with Opus 5.5 and the Borderlands 2 SDK on a friend-suggested side project; full features are not disclosed.
cases.author: @ZooL_Smith

cases.title: 把 tldraw 的猫变成可玩角色
cases.summary: tldraw 团队称 Opus 5.5 将 flash 示例中的猫做成可玩版本；未披露玩法实现细节。
cases.summary_en: The tldraw team reports Opus 5.5 making its flash example’s whimsical cat playable, without detailing the implementation.
cases.author: @tldraw

cases.title: After Effects 魔法阵重制
cases.title_en: Recreating a magic circle in After Effects
cases.summary: 作者比较五年前手工制作的魔法阵与 Opus 5.5 在 AE 中约五分钟制作的版本；耗时为作者报告，图像不全部归给Opus。
cases.summary_en: The author compares a five-year-old handmade magic circle with an Opus 5.5 AE version reportedly made in five minutes; the images include both creators’ work.
cases.author: @komonogame

cases.title: 德语广告配音前改写视觉笑点
cases.title_en: Adapting a visual joke for German dubbing
cases.summary: 作者在真实广告上测试 Opus 5.5 德语本地化，称模型识别不适合目标市场的视觉笑点，改写后再生成配音；没有公布广告或效果数据。
cases.summary_en: The author reports Opus 5.5 flagging a visual gag in an ad and rewriting it for German before voice generation; the ad and campaign metrics are not disclosed.
cases.author: @GesoraMeshack

cases.title: CodeRabbit MV 的开源制作流程
cases.summary: 作者此前展示 Opus 5.5 制作的 CodeRabbit 兔子生活 MV，本次公开代码及制作细节：Cursor 中八个视频子代理、三个研究代理，Demucs 分离人声、stable-ts 对齐歌词，接触表复审镜头；自报不到四小时、约200美元。其他作者视频仅为风格参考。
cases.summary_en: The author expands the earlier Opus 5.5 CodeRabbit rabbit video with source code: eight video and three research agents in Cursor, Demucs vocal separation, stable-ts alignment and contact-sheet reviews. Under four hours and about $200 are self-reported; other videos were references.
cases.author: @IndraVahan

cases.title: 轨道 AI 数据中心交互示意
cases.summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 编写 OC-1 卫星模型，可展开散热器、剖开机体、查看辐射与激光链路；数字源于作者引用的试验，不能当实际航天设备验证。
cases.summary_en: The author codes an OC-1 satellite with Opus 5.5, exposing radiators, internals, radiation and laser links; quoted figures do not validate a real spacecraft.
cases.author: @adriancortexbt

cases.title: 按画面调整翻译配音
cases.summary: 作者报告 Opus 5.5 先理解视频画面，再调整译文以匹配可见内容，结合 ElevenLabs 的配音流程；未提供具体语言或样片细节。
cases.summary_en: The author reports Opus 5.5 examining video content and adapting translated lines to match the visuals in an ElevenLabs dubbing workflow.
cases.author: @ethan_walker_ai

cases.title: Scale With Brew 的人审视频生产
cases.title_en: Human-reviewed video production at Scale With Brew
cases.summary: 服务团队称 Opus 5.5 支持视频制作，AI负责生产，人类负责复核、修改和质检，交付视频与缩略图；具体模型和其他工具分工未完全披露。
cases.summary_en: The team credits Opus 5.5 in a production service where AI creates videos and humans review, revise and quality-check before delivering video and thumbnail.
cases.author: @drecamz

cases.title: Blender 从零制作应用广告
cases.title_en: An app ad built from scratch in Blender
cases.summary: 作者把 Opus 5.5 接到 Blender，为自有应用制作逐帧广告，并称形成可复用流程；此前广告无ROI的记录是背景，当前广告效果未知。
cases.summary_en: The author connects Opus 5.5 to Blender for an app ad and reports a reusable frame-by-frame workflow; campaign performance is not established.
cases.author: @amritwt

cases.title: Stoneframe 逐砖建房动画
cases.summary: 作者展示 Opus 5.5 制作的 Stoneframe，主题是房屋逐砖建造；未给出结构工程或施工正确性验证。
cases.summary_en: The author presents Stoneframe made with Opus 5.5, showing a house built brick by brick; engineering accuracy is not verified.
cases.author: @LexnLin

cases.title: 口语反馈修改脚本再生成配音
cases.summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 起草并按自然语言反馈修改配音脚本，再交 ElevenLabs 合成最终音频，称已替代文档里的脚本工作。
cases.summary_en: The author has Opus 5.5 draft and revise voiceover scripts from natural-language feedback, then sends the final text to ElevenLabs.
cases.author: @AI_Workflow_Hub

cases.title: Thruwire 检查点功能解说
cases.summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 制作动画，解释在 Thruwire 中创建和使用检查点；未提供具体制作流程。
cases.summary_en: The author shares an Opus 5.5 animation explaining how to build and use checkpoints in Thruwire.
cases.author: @sethrosen

cases.title: 比较对 Yle 文章偏差的分析
cases.title_en: Comparing analyses of a Yle article

cases.summary_en: The author asks Grok, Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Luna to examine framing, wording, source balance and omitted perspectives in a Yle article; political claims are not independently established.

cases.title: 四队夺旗船战的视觉迭代
cases.title_en: Visual variants for four-team capture the flag
cases.summary: 作者已有 Three.js 多人夺旗船战，让 Opus 5.5 尝试新的视觉风格；并未声称模型从头实现全部多人逻辑。
cases.summary_en: The author uses Opus 5.5 for new looks in an existing Three.js multiplayer ship game with four teams; the full game logic is not attributed to the model.

cases.title: Gifsy 产品视频
cases.summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 通过少量提示为 gifsy.fun 制作视频并分享结果；未披露素材和音轨来源。
cases.summary_en: The author creates a video for gifsy.fun with a few Opus 5.5 prompts; asset and soundtrack sources are not disclosed.
cases.author: @WhyParabola

cases.title: 六个子代理协作制作 CRM

cases.title: macOS 风格作品集的再次比较

cases.summary_en: The author reused a portfolio prompt with Opus 5.5, reporting a day and 21,000 lines of code and preferring it over three earlier models; $363 is an API-equivalent estimate, not the subscription charge.

cases.title: 不断扩展的里斯本电车旅程

cases.summary_en: The author shares a live demo and code for an expanding Lisbon tram scene with seasons, rain, fog and day-night changes, reportedly created in pure code with Opus 5.5.
cases.author: @thebuggeddev

cases.summary_en: The creator reports using Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra to build a dryad with root-based crawling, enemy draining and leaf-wall defense in about a day and a half. They iterate from effect sketches to animation to VFX; individual model contributions are unspecified.
cases.author: @Stefan_3D_AI

cases.title: 奥德赛独眼巨人洞穴游戏
cases.summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 制作《奥德赛》独眼巨人洞穴场景游戏，目标是在船员逐一遇险时救出队伍；展示视频，未独立试玩或验证完整玩法。

cases.summary_en: The creator shows an ink horse, clay-style penguin and lakeside sunset, reporting that Opus 5.5 code generated the visuals and sound without video models or ready-made assets. Frame-level control is claimed, not independently reproduced.

cases.summary_en: The creator asked Opus 5.5 for a train-window viewing experience and shared two videos, highlighting the night view. Code, interaction details and production cost were not disclosed.

cases.title: 可观测宇宙的三维模型
cases.summary: 作者展示称由 Opus 5.5 制作的可观测宇宙三维模型；正文未给出天文数据来源、尺度准确性或实现细节。
cases.summary_en: The creator presents a 3D model of the observable universe attributed to Opus 5.5. The post does not provide astronomical data sources, scale validation or implementation details.
cases.author: @Skylartkitchen

cases.title: Mnemos 记忆系统的实时可视化
cases.title_en: A live visualizer for Mnemos memory
cases.summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 为 Mnemos 记忆引擎制作交互式实时查看器，展示召回、连接强度和巩固，并借此定位修复多处缺陷；只展示部分数据，公开发布尚未完成，不证明模型有主观体验。
cases.summary_en: The developer says Opus 5.5 built an interactive Mnemos memory viewer showing recall, connection strengths and consolidation, helping find and fix bugs. It displays a subset of data and is not yet publicly released; this does not establish subjective experience.
cases.author: @RileyRalmuto

cases.title: 一千代的 JavaScript 进化模拟
cases.summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 编写100个生物生存、繁殖和突变的模拟，自报一千代后体型增长49.6%、视野缩小51.7%；可调种子、突变率和资源，不能当作生物学验证。
cases.summary_en: The creator used Opus 5.5 to simulate survival, reproduction and mutation for 100 organisms in JavaScript. They report 49.6% larger bodies and 51.7% narrower vision after 1,000 generations; this is a tunable simulation, not biological validation.
cases.author: @morpheusdv

cases.title: 把《硅基自然：回潮》改成双语动画
cases.title_en: A bilingual animated Silicon Nature story
cases.summary: 作者将自己的讽刺故事交给 Opus 5.5，要求做成英文讲解、中英字幕的二维动画并展示视频；BBC音色只是提示要求，未核验声音来源或其宣称的变现潜力。
cases.summary_en: The creator turned their satirical story into an Opus 5.5 2D animation with requested English narration and Chinese/English subtitles. A BBC-like voice was a prompt request; voice sourcing and monetization claims were not verified.
