cases.title: 厨房改造的三维分步说明
cases.summary: 作者展示用 Opus 5.5 为自家厨房改造生成的三维分步说明；未提供完整测量、施工校验或独立安全验证。
cases.summary_en: The creator shows step-by-step 3D guidance for remodeling their kitchen with Opus 5.5. Full measurements, construction checks and independent safety validation were not provided.
cases.author: @Skylartkitchen

cases.title: 一万七千栋建筑的城市场景
cases.title_en: A city scene with over 17,000 buildings
cases.summary: 作者将此前展示的特拉维夫城市游戏场景归于 Opus 5.5，称含一万七千余建筑、数百NPC和车辆，渲染超六小时、资产超40GB；这些规模数字为作者自述。
cases.summary_en: The creator attributes their Tel Aviv city-game scene to Opus 5.5 and reports over 17,000 buildings, hundreds of NPCs and cars, six-plus rendering hours and 40 GB of assets. These are creator-reported figures.
cases.author: @saltjsx

cases.title: 用花朵展示神经网络概念
cases.summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 用花朵演示深度、生成、涌现和神经元，并制作讲解视频；称评论区提供项目与体验地址，教学正确性未独立核验。
cases.summary_en: The creator asked Opus 5.5 to illustrate depth, generation, emergence and neurons with flowers and an explainer video. They say project links are in the replies; the teaching content was not independently checked.
cases.author: @LufzzLiz

cases.title: WeirdML v3 的代理式机器学习评测
cases.title_en: Opus on the agentic WeirdML v3 benchmark
cases.summary: WeirdML 发布者报告 Opus 5.5 xhigh 在含11项机器学习与数据分析任务的 v3 评测上得31.2%，高于 Fable 的26.0%、低于 Astra 的42.2%，并称成本不到 Opus 5 一半；为该次基准报告。
cases.summary_en: The WeirdML publisher reports Opus 5.5 xhigh scoring 31.2% across 11 ML and data-analysis tasks, above Fable at 26.0% and below Astra at 42.2%, at less than half Opus 5’s cost. These are benchmark-publisher results.
cases.author: @htihle

cases.title: Qortex 的 Sol 执行与 Opus 架构审计
cases.title_en: Qortex pairs Sol execution with Opus architecture audits
cases.summary: Qortex 自述双模型工程框架：Sol 执行工具操作，Opus 5.5 在提交前审查差异及架构不变量，结合沙箱、回滚与缓存。文中毫秒延迟、72.4%成本下降及零漂移均为平台未经复现的主张。
cases.summary_en: Qortex describes Sol executing tool actions and Opus 5.5 auditing diffs and architectural invariants before commits, with sandboxing, rollback and caching. Millisecond timings, a 72.4% cost reduction and zero drift are unreplicated platform claims.
cases.author: @28qortex

cases.title: 为 1kpapers 制作发布视频
cases.summary: 作者把已上线的 1kpapers 应用交给 Opus 5.5，一次生成带动画与图表的发布视频；应用中的1000篇论文摘要由 DeepSeek V4 Flash 制作，未混归给 Opus。
cases.summary_en: The author gave the existing 1kpapers app to Opus 5.5 and reports a one-shot launch video with animations and charts. The app’s 1,000 paper summaries were produced with DeepSeek V4 Flash, not Opus.
cases.author: @nutlope

cases.title: 招聘带回作业的双模型测试
cases.title_en: Comparing models on a recruiting take-home test
cases.summary: Codos 的作者报告 Opus 5.5 一次完成原本能挑战候选人的招聘编程作业，而 Astra 两次失败，因此准备提高难度；题目与评分过程未公开。
cases.summary_en: A Codos author reports that Opus 5.5 solved a challenging recruiting coding exercise in one attempt while Astra failed twice, prompting plans for a harder test. The task and scoring process are not disclosed.
cases.author: @KSimback

cases.title: 用滚动动画让网站表现产品
cases.title_en: A website that reveals the product through scroll animation
cases.summary: 设计师展示与 Opus 5.5 协作编码的高级滚动动画网站原型，称网站可变成产品展示；正式上线仍是未来计划。
cases.summary_en: A designer showcases an advanced scroll-animation website coded with Opus 5.5, framing the site itself as a product presentation. Launch dates remain forthcoming.
cases.author: @Fluxora_Studios

cases.title: 从 note 文章生成高管恋爱游戏风 PV
cases.title_en: A dating-game-style executive promo from a note article
cases.summary: 作者仅提供 note 文章链接，让 Opus 5.5 一次制作执行董事的恋爱游戏风宣传片；未公开其他素材和制作工具。
cases.summary_en: The author supplied a note article URL and reports a one-prompt Opus 5.5 promotional video presenting an executive in a dating-game style. Other assets and tools are unspecified.
cases.author: @hello_sugimoto

cases.title: 依据法国树种地图构建数据驱动模型
cases.title_en: Data-driven tree models from a French species map
cases.summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 将 IGN 树种地图中的分类逐项对照野外指南和照片，编写数据驱动的3D树木模型；没有独立核查物种识别和建模精度。
cases.summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 checked IGN tree-species categories against field guides and photos, then coded data-driven 3D models. Species identification and model accuracy were not independently verified.
cases.author: @AaronJBecker

cases.title: 天气交易机器人中的 Opus 简报与 Jev 决策
cases.title_en: Opus briefs and Jev decisions in a weather-trading bot
cases.summary: 发布者描述天气市场机器人：Opus 5.5 写简报与处理少数难例，Jev 根据结构化预测和价格决定买入、跳过或等待，代码执行并记日志。引用中的利润、次数与速度是发布者主张，未验证交易记录。
cases.summary_en: The poster describes Opus 5.5 writing briefs and handling rare difficult cases, Jev deciding buy/skip/wait from forecasts and prices, and code executing and logging. Profit, trade-count and latency claims in the quoted post are unverified.
cases.author: @polykinder

cases.title: 天野尚风格的 Three.js 水族箱
cases.summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 在 Three.js 制作天野尚水景风格的水族箱，并称加入大和沼虾；关于3D问题已被解决的评价不作为结论。
cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 for a Three.js aquarium inspired by Takashi Amano and reports that it includes Amano shrimp. Their claim that 3D graphics are solved is not treated as a finding.
cases.author: @aollivier82

cases.title: Jev 为 Opus 工作流选择上下文与验证路径
cases.title_en: Jev selects context and verification paths for Opus
cases.summary: 作者在自己的工作流中用 Jev 选项目笔记、分派简单任务、选择工具失败恢复和定向测试，Opus 5.5 处理复杂推理；约80%的成本与时间下降是自述，无独立数据。
cases.summary_en: The author uses Jev to select project notes, route simple tasks, recover from tool failures and choose targeted tests, while Opus 5.5 handles difficult reasoning. The claimed roughly 80% cost and time reduction is unverified.
cases.author: @arle0x

cases.title: A/B 审计 Laravel Boost 指南
cases.summary: 作者建议保留 Boost MCP，对各条 skills 与规则做有无对照，移除模型已自然遵循的内容，并提供 Laravel、Inertia、Vue 的精简文件；90%遵循率与50%额外成本是作者估计。
cases.summary_en: The author proposes keeping Boost MCP, testing each guideline with and without it, and removing redundant rules, sharing a compact Laravel/Inertia/Vue file. The 90% adherence and 50% cost overhead figures are author estimates.
cases.author: @ClaudioDekker

cases.title: Nilo 资产与 Opus 代码组成 Roblox 卡牌对战
cases.title_en: A Roblox card battler with Nilo assets and Opus code
cases.summary: Nilo 团队用自身工具制作角色、动画与2D/3D物品，让 Opus 5.5 编写 Roblox 1v1 卡牌游戏代码；素材生成与游戏编程的职责明确分开。
cases.summary_en: Nilo’s team creates characters, animations and 2D/3D items with its tools, while Opus 5.5 writes code for a Roblox 1v1 card game. Asset generation and game programming remain distinct roles.
cases.author: @NiloTechInc

cases.title: 《Shard of Dawn》阿语动画试播集

cases.title: 把多种影像演出技法汇成视频
cases.title_en: Summarizing visual-production techniques in a video

cases.summary_en: The author asks Opus 5.5 to collect different visual-production techniques into a video and shares the output. The post does not list the techniques or tools, so no unseen details are inferred.

cases.title: 用 Jev 分流昂贵的 Opus 决策

cases.summary_en: The author outlines mapping costly actions, building state before Jev calls, reserving Opus for hard reasoning, testing in shadow mode and verifying execution. Speed and cost improvements are claims without measurements.
cases.author: @0xMorlex

cases.title: Modulify 上的 Aethon 网站演示
cases.title_en: An Aethon website demo on Modulify
cases.summary: 发布者展示他人使用 Modulify 免费额度与 Opus 5.5 制作的 Aethon 网站，并给出在线演示；未确认具体作者、功能或独立运行结果。
cases.summary_en: The poster showcases an Aethon website someone built with Modulify free credits and Opus 5.5, linking a live demo. The original creator, features and runtime behavior were not independently confirmed.
cases.author: @BardhylBytyqi

cases.title: 美国移民主题的视频制作

cases.summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 coded an SPY/VIX rule, swept 56 parameter combinations, used a time-split test and sent close-of-day signals. The claimed 28-second runtime and operational results are unverified and do not demonstrate profitability.

cases.summary: 官方研究的二手详述：健身App从表和图到热力图；config草图Low约1分钟、Max28分钟；存储崩溃Low0/5到Xhigh4/5，蛋白质组分析Low0/5到High4/5。流程是先问清规格、Low迭代、High验证；这些不保证错误思路被纠正。
cases.summary_en: A detailed secondary account of the official study covers fitness apps gaining heatmaps, a config prototype taking one minute on Low versus twenty-eight on Max, storage crashes improving from 0/5 on Low to 4/5 on Xhigh, and proteomics from 0/5 to 4/5 on High. The workflow clarifies the specification, iterates on Low and validates on High; more effort need not fix a wrong approach.
